posts.title: Marvel Rivals Incursion Point: 18v18 Map, Arcade Event, Patch Notes
posts.description: Marvel Rivals’ Nov. 26 patch adds Incursion Point, an 18 vs. 18 map, plus three bundles, the Ghostworks Arcade and a Black Friday sale that ends Dec. 1. The Steam post lists bug fixes and no hero tuning.

posts.title: Deadlock Patch Notes (Nov. 26): Economy, Midboss and Item Changes
posts.description: Valve’s Nov. 26 Deadlock update cuts base health by 8%, raises the first kill bonus to 175 souls, reworks comeback souls and trims the Midboss. Item changes and the Nov. 27 Apollo and Baba tweaks come with before and after values.

posts.title: Phasmophobia Resonance Patch Notes: Dowsing Rods, Ghost Changes, Unity 6
posts.description: Phasmophobia v0.20.0.0 Resonance went live on Nov. 24, 2026: Unity 6, new lighting, Dowsing Rods, changes to Yurei, Poltergeist and Goryo, and a Nov. 26 fix.
